positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: how was the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration established and what confirms it holds?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the spectrograph is calibrated at 88.4 MHz; src-2 asserts verification against June reference plates across the full observing band. Both are Quill Ashgrove's assertive statements establishing and confirming the calibration state — one directional read spans them.

positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationParameters
positions.frame: what instrument and calibration parameters define this observation session?
positions.why: src-3 declares the instrument as the Kestrelwood spectrograph; src-4 declares the calibration as 88.4 MHz verified against June reference plates. Both are declarative labels specifying the session's instrument configuration — one directional read spans them.
